messages.text:
The build has moved past the API routes; the current Start default entry expects `src/router.tsx` to export `createRouter`, while my file exported `getRouter`.

I’m aligning that and isolating Vitest from the Start Vite plugin so database/API tests run as backend tests instead of triggering route generation.
